item.title: Choose a Better Check for a Public Briefing
item.prompt_text: A community centre explains how to renew a room booking. During its pilot, only three visitors asked questions. The organiser says this proves the explanation was clear. Several visitors later returned with half-completed forms. Explain why the question count is limited, propose one inexpensive check, and say how you would use the result before the next session.
item.audience: the organiser of a short public information session
item.target_grammar: Cautious interpretations with may, could and suggests. Use conditional comparisons.
item.target_structure: Summarise the evidence, suggest an observable check, and set a rule for revising the explanation.

checklist.point: Explain why the question count is inconclusive.
Connect the incomplete forms to a specific possible difficulty.
Propose a practical check of understanding.
Say how the result should inform a future revision.
